title: Roommate W: Futari
overview: Roommate W: Futari is a love-simulation adventure game and part of the Roommate series. It takes place after the events of the previous games, featuring two new heroines who have moved in with the protagonist: Yūko Yamaguchi, a high school senior from Sendai; and Kaori Satō, a university nursing student from Shizuoka. The format is the same as previous games: the player can move around the apartment and speak with either of the girls, responding to their conversation via multiple choice prompts. As in the previous titles, in-game events are affected not just by the player's dialogue choices, but also by time and frequency of gameplay.
